author: Trinitos
quote: After 50 hours of gameplay, countless bugs, the launch of GTA 6 might be worse than that of Cyberpunk and perhaps even worse than that of Pokémon Scarlet and Violet, with sloppy dialogue, a repetitive story, and none of the humor or arcade-style gameplay found in previous GTA games, it feels much more like RDR2 set in modern times than a GTA 6 game.
